The '''Arkinnea Militia ''' was the local military forces of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkinnea]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The Arkinneans suffered greatly under the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and after the war they slaughtered the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from former Separatist planets and also from former Republic worlds.
